components.description: Federal FMLA leave as the Handbook incorporates it: up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a rolling 12-month period for a birth or care of a newborn, adoption or foster placement, the employee's own serious health condition (Section D, including pregnancy incapacity), or care of a spouse, child or parent with a serious health condition (Section K). One 12-week entitlement for all these purposes.
components.faculty_group_note: Faculty Handbook policy for 'professorial faculty, lecturers, and instructors' (full-time); the Handbook applies 'to all full-time faculty employed by Boston University regardless of Tenure-Track, Tenured, or Non-Tenure-Track status' (2018_04). Footnote [1] concerns School of Medicine practice-plan faculty (see notes).
components.eligible_parent_wording: pregnancy, birth, or adoption of a child, or for the assumption of new foster care; Birth or care of a well newborn child; employee's own serious health condition; care of a family member with a serious health condition
components.entitlement_note: A statutory entitlement (FMLA) stays guaranteed even though the policy requires an application form.
components.duration_note: Section A: 'up to twelve weeks'; Leave Entitlement: 'Total of 12 weeks (FMLA) ... less any leave used during the rolling 12-month period'. Statute: 'a total of 12 workweeks'. The same 12 weeks serve the parental (A), own-medical (D) and family-illness (K) purposes.
components.statute_source: 29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)(A)-(D) (length and purposes); 29 U.S.C. 2611(2) (12 months and 1,250 hours)

sequence.note: Policy deems FMLA/MPLA parental leave to run concurrently with paid Childbirth Leave (S1). FMLA also runs concurrently with Temporary Disability Leave pay (Section E), stated in notes, not linked, to avoid a second placing link.

components.relief_note: Leave of absence; relief not stated (R9).
components.return_obligation: none stated; return right: 'entitled to return to the same or similar position'
components.notice: 30 days' notice when foreseeable (Sections D, K); application form via the chair

Birth parent chain: Childbirth Leave 6 weeks (c3) within Full-Modified Workload Reduction for the rest of that semester (c4, one semester; R3b), or the Half-Modified alternative (c5, in_lieu_of c4); if unable to work beyond six weeks, Temporary Disability Leave (c8, 3 months for a two-year member) consecutive_after c3, with its full-salary pay (c9) within it; FMLA 12 (c1) and MPLA 8 (c2) concurrent_with c3 from its start.
Non-birth parent chain: Workload Reduction one semester as primary caregiver (c4) or the half option (c5); FMLA 12 (c1) and MPLA 8 (c2) alongside (their link to c3 does not count for this role).

Calendar: no document states the term length; the Handbook's semesters are the kind of term. calendar is omitted, and the term length follows R8's order: the institution's 2017-18 academic calendar gives 16 weeks.

Term length (R8): the documents speak throughout of semesters without a length. The Workload Reduction section equates a semester of full relief to 'fourteen consecutive weeks' for Medical Campus teaching outside the semester structure; that is a relief equivalence, not a stated term length, so the calendar's 16 weeks is used (v1 used 14).

Workload Reduction timing: the relief may be taken any time within 16 months of the birth ('does not affect subsequent eligibility'), so a birth parent could take Childbirth Leave and then a later semester of relief (6 + one semester). Coded per R3b's Boston University example (the leave within the relief); the later-semester placement is a window only (R15) and is not coded as an alternative. Possible R15b timing alternative (cf. Penn State).

FMLA (c1) also runs concurrently with Temporary Disability Leave pay (Section E: 'FMLA leave runs concurrently with the pay continuation benefit'); linked only to c3 to keep one placing link. FMLA Sections A (parental), D (own serious health condition) and K (family illness) are one 12-week entitlement, coded as one component.

Footnote [1]: School of Medicine professorial faculty, lecturers and instructors with practice-plan employment contracts receive Faculty Practice Foundation benefits instead of the Handbook's; this does not touch main-campus (Charles River) faculty.
Job protection: 'A faculty member on an approved leave of absence is entitled to return to the same or similar position' applies to every approved leave.

Footnote [4]: requests for leave or workload reduction 'for other circumstances related to family responsibilities' are outside the policy and considered case by case by the Provost; not a component (no birth or adoption purpose beyond the coded provisions).

Sabbatical (2018_03): any semester including a leave or Workload Reduction does not count toward sabbatical service; Junior Scholar Leave not barred by prior Childbirth Leave or Workload Reduction. Research leaves, not components.

Cross-references not saved: Massachusetts Parental Leave Act; Massachusetts Earned Sick Time Law; Massachusetts Domestic Violence Leave Law; Massachusetts Small Necessities Leave Act; USERRA; Massachusetts Workers' Compensation Law; Long-Term Disability Plan and the Faculty and Staff Benefits Handbook; 'Tenure Review Schedule and Notification' (tenure policy); Faculty Request for Non-Academic Leave of Absence form; Primary Caregiver Workload Reduction request form; Faculty Practice Foundation policies (Medical School practice-plan faculty only).
Statutory baseline: FMLA verified against statute texts 2026_00 and 2026_01. MA PFML is mentioned in no saved document (absent). No MA statute text is saved.
